# Topic map

**Generated rollup. Do not edit by hand.** The librarian regenerates this table from `kb/status/<domain>.md`. Each domain's status file is the source of truth, so parallel domain runs never overwrite each other.

Ownership: the editor-in-chief owns in-progress status (planned, researching, drafting, review, testing, paused, linked) in each status file; the librarian owns the shipped version field and this rollup. Shared defaults: `kb/FOUNDATIONS.md`. Exemplar set: `kb/exemplars.md`.
